verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM and AI-Assisted Review provide contract storage, clause flagging, and playbook-based analysis, and the MCP connector explicitly retrieves 'agreement context and metadata', 'key dates', and 'clauses and agreement insights', indicating structured extraction. However, there's no explicit description of a searchable repository UI/index or independent verification of extraction accuracy. Missing for 10: dedicated repository/search interface documentation, third-party validation of metadata extraction quality, and detail on full-text/metadata search capabilities.
